Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.item

Class FluidBucketItem

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.item.Item
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.item.SomeBucketItem
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.item.FluidBucketItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.world.flag.FeatureElement, net.minecraft.world.level.ItemLike
Direct Known Subclasses:
BBItem, SBItem
public abstract class FluidBucketItem extends SomeBucketItem
Base of the mod's single-fluid-container buckets (Big, Huge, and Source Bucket): the fluid container rules every loader's fluid storage and the shared fluid logic apply, content naming, the crafting remainder contract, lava fuel, cow milking, milk drinking, the item-model state protocol, and the gesture helpers both item classes share.

The container rules are pure: acceptable(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.StoredFluid) and extractable(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, int) preview a transfer in StoredFluid terms without changing the stack, and insert(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.StoredFluid, int) and extract(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, int) commit exactly what the preview allowed. A finite Big or Huge Bucket stores what it takes up to its capacity; a Source Bucket admits only allowlisted fluids, keeps nothing beyond its assigned identity, and supplies or sinks one bucket volume per call without depleting.

    • isLavaFuel

      public static boolean isLavaFuel(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack)
      Reports whether stack currently provides bucket-grade lava fuel. Finite buckets need at least one full unit; a Source Bucket must also retain an allowed lava assignment.

    • milkInto

      protected final net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult milkInto(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.entity.animal.Cow cow, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand hand, int capacityMb)
      Milks cow into the held bucket, adding one bucket volume of milk up to capacityMb. The caller has checked that the bucket can take milk. Milking is routed through the cow's own interaction; the client predicts the vanilla feedback and the server records the unit only after an authorized interaction consumes the action. A stack of empty buckets fills one.

    • isBlockTarget

      protected static boolean isBlockTarget(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult hit, boolean includeCauldrons)
      Reports whether a hit targets a block the bucket interacts with as a block, from useOn: an exposed loader fluid store, or a vanilla cauldron when includeCauldrons. Vanilla dispatch posts the loader's block-interaction event before useOn, which is where claim mods decide whether a player may use a block.

    • withoutBlockTarget

      protected static net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult withoutBlockTarget(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, boolean includeCauldrons)
      Converts a hit on a block target (see isBlockTarget(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult, boolean)) into a miss, so use leaves that block to useOn.

    • beforeWorldBucketUse

      @Nullable protected static net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult beforeWorldBucketUse(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, Supplier<net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult> hitSupplier)
      Lazily posts Forge's world bucket-use event when hitSupplier resolves a block hit. Fabric returns without resolving the supplier, so loader-neutral item code does not pay for Forge-only target selection.

    • tryShiftClear

      protected static boolean tryShiftClear(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult airHit)
      Clears an assigned bucket on a sneak-use against air. airHit is the caller's own ClipContext.Fluid.NONE raytrace, shared with tryCrossHandTransfer(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult).
      Returns:
      true iff the interaction was handled (the bucket had content to clear)

    • tryCrossHandTransfer

      protected static boolean tryCrossHandTransfer(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand hand, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult airHit)
      Transfers content with whatever the other hand holds, deliberately restricted to right-clicking air: a targeted block means the player expects the bucket to act on that block instead. airHit is the caller's own ClipContext.Fluid.NONE raytrace.
      Returns:

    • finishMilkDrink

      protected final void finishMilkDrink(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity user, boolean drain)
      Completes a milk drink of one bucket volume as vanilla's milk bucket does: the consume-item criterion and item-use statistic against the still-filled stack, then effect clearing on the server. A finite bucket drains one unit on the server; an infinite Source Bucket does not.
